Synopsis:
    ICE agent Christian Castro has been federally indicted on six counts of making false statements related to the January 2025 shooting of Venezuelan national Julio Cesar Sosa-Celis during Trump's Minnesota deportation campaign. Castro faces parallel state charges in Minnesota but has been shielded from extradition by Texas Governor Abbott. A federal prosecutor working the case was fired and is now himself under investigation for obstruction. The ACLU is taking on a civil lawsuit against the Trump administration on Sosa-Celis' behalf. The case sits at the intersection of federal immigration enforcement, state-federal jurisdictional conflict, and civil rights law, with investigations still active.
